rule: These are contextual projections on atomic RAKL method fibers. This delta is append-only evidence and must be folded into a future normalized atlas without deleting the source-specific scope guards.

entries.retained_projection: validate a candidate before promotion; require successful checks and optionally bind an expected source integration
entries.rakl_extension: bind checks to the exact candidate SHA, freeze evaluator fingerprints, require active main to remain on the incumbent until verdict, then non-forced fast-forward
entries.cannot_see: a required-check system alone does not prove scientific validity and does not prevent self-certification if the candidate is allowed to weaken the evaluator

entries.retained_projection: state properties over input families and generate examples that try to refute them; minimize/reduce failures into useful counterexamples
entries.rakl_extension: use property/metamorphic tests for RAKL invariants such as context symmetry, relation-order invariance, retry idempotency and immutable semantic identity
entries.cannot_see: generated software invariants do not substitute for source-grounded scientific benchmarks or guarantee the chosen invariant is epistemically correct

entries.retained_projection: represent derivation and production history as a first-class provenance graph rather than burying lineage in prose
entries.cannot_see: provenance does not by itself establish evidence truth, independence, strength or causal identification

entries.retained_projection: keep alternative derivation paths in an inspectable DAG/circuit and compose lineage algebraically instead of flattening it to one citation list
entries.cannot_see: a provenance semiring/circuit encodes derivational structure; it must not be conflated with RAKL authority, evidence quality or mechanistic identification

entries.retained_projection: separate assertion content, provenance and publication/process information in an atomic scholarly object
entries.rakl_extension: add exact evidence spans, contradiction/omission coverage and RAKL authority separately from identity/signature metadata
entries.cannot_see: signature or stable identity provides integrity/attribution, not scientific truth

entries.retained_projection: append-only event history permits replay/reconstruction; deterministic workflow state and side-effectful activities require different correctness rules
entries.rakl_extension: make planning/evaluation replay-safe while commits, branch moves and experiments carry explicit side-effect identities and idempotency/receipt rules
entries.cannot_see: durable execution correctness does not decide scientific evidence authority or whether a research conclusion is true

corroboration_only: GitHub required checks corroborate the existing fail-closed test-honesty principle
W3C PROV corroborates the already adopted append-only provenance direction
new_retained_objects: compositional provenance algebra distinct from evidence strength
assertion/provenance/process separation for atomic claim packets
durable/replay-safe research execution with idempotent side effects
